label: Scene Template: Kinetic Manifesto
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: the kinetic-type statement beat. ONE sentence owns the frame, landing word by word with scale/weight contrast; accent words slam in brand color with a camera punch. Use for the film's thesis line, a pivotal claim, or a short emotional statement (4-14 words) -- the pure-typography breath between denser scenes. Dark by default.

text.label: The sentence (4-14 words). Wrap key words in *stars* to accent them

accent_words.label: Alternative to stars: words to accent in brand color

logo_url.label: Wordmark URL; defaults to the brand-kit wordmark

uniform.label: true = all words same size (skip the small-connective-word shrink)
